# Test site data

A frozen copy of the site's data from 2026-11-18T11:31:25+00:00: 112 catalog games, their files, Steam media
and Steam store facts (price, rating, Steam Deck).
Tests read it and the preview server serves it (`RADAR_SITE_DATA`). Regenerate on purpose with
`python scripts/make_test_site_data.py` and review the diff like any other test change.
